pages.text: $(italic)The builder and engineer. An average fighter with no combat tradeoffs, whose power comes from crafting and infrastructure.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: 0% (no penalty)  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() none, and no weapon penalties

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Mastery$(): +15% mining speed with every tool.$(br2)$(bold)Engineer's Efficiency$(): +10% attack speed.$(br2)$(bold)Resourceful$(): a crafting table within 4 blocks gives you Speed I (+20% movement speed).$(br2)Ores drop as they do for anyone: no class gets bonus ore.

pages.title: The Builder's Path
pages.text: The $(thing)Artificer$() is the only class with no combat tradeoffs. It is an average fighter and excels at everything else. If you would rather spend your time on building, crafting and automation than on combat, this is your class.

pages.title: Race Pairings
pages.text: $(thing)Dwarf$(): +15% mining speed, which adds to Crafting Mastery's +15%, and half damage from fire on Nether resource runs.$(br2)$(thing)Halfling$(): food goes 20% further and +1 luck improves your loot rolls, for long gathering trips.$(br2)$(thing)Human$(): +10% XP and no weaknesses, for jack-of-all-trades building.
